target: Editorial Office onboarding, Office, Mission, Company, employee folio, and employee details

references: Company and employee details: artifacts/design/approved/editorial-office/company-members.png plus employee-details.png

probes.summary: The living monochrome office stays primary while a selected employee opens in a dismissible editorial folio.
A Linear-like grouped task list uses the same paper, type, rules, and black action language as the rest of the product.
The company relationship wall presents humans and AI employees as one organization without reading as HR software.

screenshots.note: Scaled evidence from the supported 760-point compact Office window.
Compact Mission retains assignee, status, date, filters, and a dismissible task inspector.
Final signed build running with larger floor-grounded employees in motion and visible company settings.

projectCheck.command: swift test (46 tests), swift build, strict OpenSpec validation, git diff --check, release package, and strict codesign verification

findings: Native SwiftUI and SpriteKit review used rebuilt-window evidence and focused source audits; browser-only static detectors were not applicable.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner approved the five Editorial Office designs and delegated final implementation judgment. The new shell is the sole visible product direction; the old playground remains only as movement/runtime substrate.
